title: Review packet publication: bound owner-guard wait and cover the remaining no-publication and terminal-branch cases
outcome: The compact packet's optional terminal publication no longer delays or times out the current result when the store-wide retention owner guard is contended, and the remaining no-publication and terminal-branch cases have behavioural tests.
acceptance: Optional packet publication does not block serving the current result on a contended owner guard; contention is reported through retainedReviewAttemptsError
A behavioural test shows an unselected output page requested before the first compact packet publishes no identity and writes no custody

Behavioural tests cover the guarded terminal-status or superseded branch, a Failed reviewer packet publishing, a Canceled reviewer packet not publishing, and no custody write on the corrupt-custody packet read
